task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a glass of water and any light snacks, and pass them to R2 when it arrives.
central_instructions.R2: Go to the kitchen to receive water and snacks from R1, then deliver them to the bedroom.
central_instructions.R3: Prepare the bedroom by arranging pillows and blankets for comfort, and wait for R2 to deliver water and snacks.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is stocked with essentials like tissues and hand sanitizer, and be ready to assist if needed.

[5-10 min]

- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up a tomato from the fridge. (r1_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the tomato into small pieces. (r1_s4)

[15-20 min]
- R2 [RECEIVE] Arrive in the kitchen to receive items. (r2_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the mug of water and sliced tomato to R2. (r1_s5)
